rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the majority narrow and text-based ("validity" proceedings only), tracking PDR Network’s threshold inquiries to avoid due-process/Article III problems while preserving Hobbs Act exclusivity for true set-aside challenges. Alito likely dissents on uniformity/anti-collateral-attack grounds, while Thomas and Gorsuch are the most likely to add separate concurrences emphasizing original meaning and separation-of-powers limits on agency binding effect in private damages suits.
